title: DEEPCRAFT™ Ready Model for Baby Cry Detection
description: Detect the sound of babies crying in the vicinity of a microphone
long_description: Accelerate your smart sensing applications with the DEEPCRAFT™ Ready Model for Baby Cry Detection. Designed for seamless edge deployment, it reliably detects baby crying events in real time, helping create more responsive and intelligent products.
